data.name: Black Noise
data.detailed_description:
The world ended long ago.

Its flesh has curdled to mud, its bones have crumbled to ash, its veins lie petrified and empty...

Its anatomy can barely support its own bloated, rotting corpse. Yet in this most broken of worlds, some things still remain. Unaware of their lot, unaware of their purpose, the Thoughtless lie in sleep. So ever faint was the whisper that reached your slumbering corpse. For you have not truly withered, but cling to what little you have left. You have awakened, so long have you been gone you have forgotten what you are.

You have seen the world for what it truly is and can never return to your peaceful rest. You will surely perish.

Key Features

  • You will surely perish by a days end. Feed off whatever you can find to just have a couple more minutes.

  • Discover the history and secrets of a world that is unable to sustain itself anymore.

  • Regain your memory of the world and people who created you.

  • Find and group together with your missing brothers and sisters so that you may not perish.

  • Perform forbidden rituals and pacts with eldritch ancients, manipulating the world and granting yourself boons so you may endure this inhospitable world.

  • Not one playthrough is the same, the world and the things you find in it change each time.
